# Evan Jacobson

> Official portfolio and resume of Evan Jacobson, a Denver-based AI and software engineer focused on reliable agents, multi-agent systems, coding-agent infrastructure, and production LLM applications.

- Canonical site: https://evanjacobson.io/
- Contact: contact@evanjacobson.io
- Location: Denver, Colorado, United States
- Current work: Software Engineer at Kilo; Technical Cofounder at OrAI

## Profile

- [Homepage and profile](https://evanjacobson.io/): Background, current work, location, and engineering focus.
- [AI engineering portfolio](https://evanjacobson.io/work): Index of case studies and technical work.
- [Resume](https://evanjacobson.io/files/Evan%20Jacobson%20Resume.pdf): Professional experience, skills, and education.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/evanjacobson): Public code and contribution history.
- [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/evanjacobson3): Professional identity and experience.

## Selected AI engineering work

- [OneDeal](https://evanjacobson.io/work/onedeal): Autonomous business-sourcing agents and an agentic web-search pipeline.
- [Trade Intel](https://evanjacobson.io/work/trade-intel): Multi-agent financial newsletter extraction pipeline.
- [Beads](https://evanjacobson.io/work/beads): Persistent structured memory for AI coding agents.
- [OrAI](https://evanjacobson.io/work/orai): Production AI applications for early childhood educators and administrators.
- [Kilo](https://evanjacobson.io/work/kilo): Work on KiloClaw and an open-source agentic engineering platform.

## Areas of expertise

- Agentic AI and AI coding agents
- AI agent reliability and quality controls
- Multi-agent workflows and orchestration
- Production LLM applications
- Full-stack AI product engineering
- TypeScript, React, Cloudflare, AWS, and OpenAI API integrations

## AI engineering toolbox

- [AI engineering toolbox](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox): Agents, cloud platforms, automation, and developer tools used in practice.
- [Kilo](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox/kilo): Open-source agentic engineering platform; daily-driver CLI and VS Code extension.
- [KiloClaw](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox/kiloclaw): Kilo's managed OpenClaw service for daily automated workflows.
- [Beads](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox/beads): Issue tracking designed for AI agents; core contributor.
- [Claude Code](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox/claude-code): Anthropic's terminal-based coding agent, semi-retired in favor of Kilo CLI.
- [Gas Town](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox/gas-town): Multi-agent swarm manager, semi-retired in favor of Gas Town by Kilo.
- [Cursor](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox/cursor): AI editor, semi-retired in favor of Kilo's VS Code extension.
- [Supabase](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox/supabase): Postgres, auth, storage, and realtime; the backend for OrAI.
- [Cloudflare Workers](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox/cloudflare-workers): Edge-first serverless compute that runs OrAI.
- [Cloudflare AI](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox/cloudflare-ai): AI Search (AutoRAG) and AI Gateway for retrieval, routing, and observability.
- [AWS](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox/aws): Lambda, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, and EC2 behind Trade Intel.
- [Terraform](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox/terraform): Infrastructure as code across dev, stage, and prod environments.
- [n8n](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox/n8n): Self-hosted workflow automation feeding multi-agent extraction pipelines.
- [GitHub Actions](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox/github-actions): CI/CD with OIDC auth for tests, deploys, and infrastructure.
- [Stripe](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox/stripe): Payment processing and subscription tiers for OrAI.
- [Playwright](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox/playwright): End-to-end browser testing for OrAI.
- [PostHog](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox/posthog): Product analytics and LLM tracing.
- [Streamlit](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox/streamlit): Python dashboards for fast data insights.
- [Graphite](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox/graphite): Stacked pull requests and Git workflow tooling.
- [Docker](https://evanjacobson.io/toolbox/docker): Containers for local development and production deploys.

## On-site apps

- [On-site apps](https://evanjacobson.io/apps): Small software tools and experiments.
- [Binary Console Image](https://evanjacobson.io/apps/binary-console): Free browser-based hacker terminal image generator producing glowing console PNGs.
- [Ultra Low Latency Doctor](https://evanjacobson.io/apps/doctor-chatbot): A joke chatbot that delivers an instant client-side diagnosis; entertainment only.
